findings.title: Reconcile the requested boot frame count before accepting healthy evidence
findings.problem: Facts::parse never reads boot.frames. Its frames_wanted and both judges use only the authority row. Consequently the requested boot count may be missing or disagree without any error. A current Synthetic::control with authority.frames=20 and authority.frames_wanted=20 passes parse and judge_control despite boot.frames=30: its 30 sound calls/requests satisfy the >=20 condition and all other checks remain satisfied. Editing boot.frames alone to 40 or omitting it is also ignored. This leaves the original requested boot/authority frame-completeness check unfinished.
findings.impact: The judge can accept a completed run against a rewritten requested count, so completion remains self-reported by the terminal row rather than tied to its configuration evidence. This is an evidence gate defect, not a demonstrated production short-run bug.
findings.requested_change: Parse boot.frames as a required valid whole count and require it to match authority.frames_wanted before constructing Facts, for healthy and stopped runs. Retain the completed frame equality checks and add finite mismatched/missing boot-count guards, including the authority.frames=frames_wanted=20 versus boot.frames=30 case. No production change or broader trace framework is needed.
findings.support: Direct source control-flow analysis only; reviewer did not execute the synthetic example.
